entries.title: Born
entries.text: Born on January 7.

entries.title: First strokes
entries.text: Started learning to swim.

entries.title: Lifeguard certificate
entries.text: Earned his lifeguard certificate.

entries.title: Water polo
entries.text: Joined the Shahid Shiroudi Stadium water polo club as a goalkeeper.

entries.title: First hobby game
entries.text: Programmed Snake, his first hobby game, in C.

entries.title: A card game in C#
entries.text: Programmed the card game Whist in C#.

entries.title: Computer science and hardware engineering
entries.text: Graduated from Shomal University. His thesis work simulated a CPU and mainboard with an FPGA and a lift-truck robot with an Atmel microcontroller.

entries.title: Persian Engine
entries.text: Started developing his first in-house game engine, Persian Engine.

entries.title: Safa
entries.text: Joined Safa's development team as a Senior Silverlight Developer on Project Sara 8.

entries.title: Founded BaziPardaz
entries.text: Founded the independent BaziPardaz game studio to develop software, simulations, interactive games, and game-engine technology.

entries.title: The Land
entries.text: Started a prototype of The Land, a third-person shooter built with Persian Engine.

entries.title: Best technology award
entries.text: Persian Engine was nominated for Best Computer Games Technology at Tehran's International Digital Media Festival and Fair and won the award.

entries.title: Persian Engine on the web
entries.text: Started porting Persian Engine to the Silverlight 5 platform.

entries.title: The Master Chef
entries.text: Started The Master Chef at BaziPardaz, an interactive game based on Kinect and Persian Engine.

entries.title: DirectX 11.1 Game Programming
entries.text: Authored DirectX 11.1 Game Programming, a step-by-step guide to creating 3D applications and games with a multithreaded C++/CX and DirectX 11.1 framework for Windows Store apps.

entries.title: DirectX Graphics Diagnostics
entries.text: Published an article about DirectX Graphics Diagnostics on GameDev.net and Packt Hub.

entries.title: A dedicated DirectX blog
entries.text: Launched a companion blog for DirectX 11.1 Game Programming, helping experienced DirectX developers explore newer DirectX 11.x features.

entries.title: City2
entries.text: Started City2, an online social-city simulation built with Persian Engine; its browser version used Silverlight 5.

entries.title: University lecturer
entries.text: Became a lecturer at the Iran University of Applied Science and Technology's National Foundation of Computer Games.

entries.title: Iran Game Development Institute
entries.text: Became a lecturer at the Iran Game Development Institute.

entries.title: Learning Modern C++
entries.text: Launched Learning Modern C++ for Game Programmers, a free, open-source self-study project for developers learning modern C++ through game programming.

entries.title: Gaming in healthcare
entries.text: Published Gaming in Healthcare at Iran's first Game and Medical Health conference.

entries.title: IGDF jury panel
entries.text: Joined the IGDF 2014 jury panel for Best Computer Games Technology.

entries.title: Persian Engine released
entries.text: Published the final version of Persian Engine, including its editor, animation mixer, and Softimage FaceRobot integration.

entries.title: Real-time playout and CG
entries.text: Started developing real-time playout and CG-editor tools based on the MOS protocol, using C++, FFmpeg, and DirectX 11.1 with Blackmagic DeckLink capture, editing, and HD/SD playback.

entries.title: Wolf Engine
entries.text: Started the next generation of his in-house game engine, Wolf Engine.

entries.title: CEO of Wolf Source
entries.text: Became CEO of Wolf Source, working across games, game engines, 3D tools, and television-broadcast technology.

entries.title: Technical book reviewer
entries.text: Reviewed Game Programming Using Qt: Beginner's Guide by Witold Wysota and Lorenz Haas, his second Packt book project after DirectX 11.1 Game Programming.

entries.title: Project Falcon
entries.text: Joined Fanap as Project Manager of Project Falcon.

entries.title: PlayPod
entries.text: Co-founded and led PlayPod, the first cloud-gaming console in Iran and the Middle East.

entries.title: Co-Founder & CTO at Arium
entries.text: Co-founded Arium as CTO, a cloud-gaming platform for peer-to-peer duels.

entries.title: Technical reviewer — Rust for C++ Programmers
entries.text: Served as technical reviewer for Rust for C++ Programmers by Mustafif Khan, published by BPB.

entries.title: Co-author of Integrating Rust
entries.text: Co-authored Integrating Rust with Abhishek Kumar, a practical guide to adopting Rust for secure, scalable, and high-performance systems.

entries.title: Fellow at PlayPod
entries.text: Exited as CEO of Alpha after steering the company to its first profit in three years, and became a Fellow at PlayPod. Since 2018, PlayPod has served more than one million Iranian gamers, was selected among the top candidates for Fit 4 Start Luxembourg in 2020, and was named the top product at the fifth Iranian Product Innovation Leaders Festival at Sharif University of Technology (Aryamehr).

entries.title: Alpha technology milestones
entries.text: During Pooya's leadership, Alpha was recognized by Iran's Vice Presidency as a knowledge-based company, delivered a digital twin for Bank Pasargad's central branch named PodVerse, and built and scaled GPU-partitioning infrastructure to allocate GPUs to PlayPod and other GPU-based projects.

entries.title: AINU
entries.text: Joined AINU Tech Source and established the company's vision as well as its technical foundations from scratch to launch AINU Invest and other upcoming projects.

entries.title: Technical reviewer — Web Development in Rust
entries.text: Served as technical reviewer for Web Development in Rust by Viktor Daróczi, published by BPB.
